title: Jumbled Sentence 93
subject: History
caption: Flowchart showing the steps to reorder a jumbled sentence into the correct Q‑P‑S‑R sequence
altText: A left‑to‑right flowchart begins with 'Original Jumbled Sentence', moves to 'Identify Parts Q, P, S, R', then branches into four nodes for each part (Q, P, S, R). All four converge on 'Place Q first', which leads to a highlighted node 'Construct Sentence: Q → P → S → R', followed by 'Validate Grammar' and finally 'Correct Sentence'.
